items.lede: The milestone comes a year after Snapchat announced a controversial limit on free storage for its Memories feature and informed users it would start requiring users to pay $1.99 per month for additional storage or subscribe to Snapchat+ to retain their Memories.
items.title: Snapchat surpasses 30M paid subscribers

items.lede: Power users seem more than willing to pay for AI-powered effects.
items.title: Snap has more than 30 million paid subscribers across Snapchat+ and other plans
